messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: privacy-high - cache-service reported potential leak of masked user identifiers in debug logs. Pager oncall: ben
ben (sre): I'm looking. root cause seems related to an edge cache dumping debug payloads after a failed purge. no confirmed customer PII but there are linkable identifiers.
maria (cs): Any customer impact known? need to prep CS heads for outreach.
ben (sre): preliminary scope: transient logs written to ephemeral cache for ~3h for a subset of requests (ingest debug=1). estimated affected: 4 customers, small % of requests.
sara (secops): mark as PII-sensitive. Kevin loop in for legal review. do not send customer notice without legal signoff.
kevin (legal): on it. need exact scope + timelines and whether data exfiltration is plausible.
ben (sre): mitigation: disabled debug flag across edge, invalidated cache keys, rotated service tokens used for logging pipeline. deploying now.
incident-bot: Status updated -> investigating -> mitigation in progress
sara (secops): prep draft status page and customer notice skeleton. I'll take initial CS template.
maria (cs): thx. if Legal ok, we'll send to impacted accounts with CSM intro.
ben (sre): handing pager to sara for continued coord. I'm available for questions. @sara you're oncall now.
sara (secops): taking it. notes: preserve logs for forensic, do not delete until Legal confirms.
ben (sre): saved snapshot, started collection (run below)
```
# commands run
kubectl -n edge logs -l app=edge-cache --since=4h > /tmp/edge-logs-collect.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/edge-logs-collect.log s3://redwood-incident-archive/1799998888/
```
sara (secops): Draft status page (short) below — please review quick:
```
We are investigating an issue with our edge cache where debug payloads were temporarily exposed in internal logs. We have disabled the debug path and invalidated affected caches. There is no evidence of customer data being publicly accessible. We are continuing an investigation and will provide updates within 6 hours.
```
kevin (legal): change "publicly accessible" -> "externally accessible". add "no indication of malicious access" if forensics supports.
sara (secops): adjusted. new draft for customer notice (to impacted accounts) below — please comment. legal tag required before send.
```
Subject: Notice regarding transient debug log exposure in edge cache

Hi <CustomerName>,

We are contacting you about a technical issue we identified on <date/time>. During a debug path which was unintentionally enabled, certain request payloads were written to ephemeral internal logs in our edge caching layer. Those logs contained identifiers associated with application requests. At this time, we have no evidence that any customer data was accessed by unauthorized third parties.

What we did:
- Immediately disabled the debug path and invalidated the affected caches.
- Rotated logging service tokens and preserved logs for forensic review.
- Notified affected teams and initiated a full investigation.

What this means for you:
- We believe a small subset of request identifiers (not full PII) for up to 4 customers may be present in internal ephemeral logs for a limited window (~3 hours).
- We have no indication of external access or malicious activity.

Next steps:
- We will share a follow-up with final scope and remediation within 48 hours.
- If you have legal or security questions, please contact <CSM> or support@redwood.com.

We apologize for the disruption and take this seriously.

— Redwood Inference
```
maria (cs): Looks good. add CSM intro line and follow-up cadence.
sara (secops): internal comms template for CSMs below (copy/paste):
```
Hi <CustomerName> — This is <CSM>. We wanted to make you aware of an incident we are investigating where debug logs from an internal edge cache may contain request identifiers tied to your account. Legal and SecOps are finalizing scope. We'll follow up within 48 hours with definitive impact and remediation. If you'd like a call, I can set one up.
```
ben (sre): confirm mitigations completed, cache invalidation finished, token rotation done. no further writes to the debug path.
incident-bot: Severity -> P2 (privacy), updated runbook step "legal notified"
kevin (legal): give me 2 hours to review wording, then ok to send to impacted customers.
sara (secops): agreed. once legal approves, we will post status page update and send customer notices. Maria please queue CSM outreach.
maria (cs): queued. will wait for legal ok then send.
sara (secops): thanks all. handing back to ben for final tech wrap once legal signoff. closing oncall transfer note.
ben (sre): acknowledged.
